name: pri-learning
description: Pri Learning — Years 7–12 maths practice with HSC-style marking and on-device handwriting recognition. Runs entirely offline; nothing leaves the iPad.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:backend && npm run test:security && npm run test:ink && npm run test:hard && npm run test:lines && npm run test:holdout && npm run test:holdout2 && npm run test:context
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:a11y
